note: The registry shipped with apok-eval: generic licences, terms and hosts for Vesuvius Challenge data, and one synthetic asset for the tests (the demo declares its own directory in a run-local copy). It declares no scroll data: declare your own inputs in a copy of this file (docs/licence.md, "Declaring your data") and pass it with --registry. This file never records anyone's acceptance of terms: an acceptance lives in a run configuration, in the words of the person who accepted. Citations are to ScrollPrize/villa at e0bbb8b unless stated.

CC-BY-NC-4.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
obligations: Attribute the source and cite the dataset that corresponds to the scans used (scrollprize.org/docs/02_data.md:56).
Non-commercial use only: nothing trained or calibrated on this data enters a paid product.
Publishing anything derived from the data is a decision for the person who accepted the data terms, under those terms; the gate cannot make it.
CC-BY-NC-4.0.evidence: vesuvius/src/vesuvius/install/accept_terms.py:55 (all Vesuvius Challenge datasets are CC BY-NC 4.0 except Scrolls 1-4 and Fragments 1-6); scrollprize.org/docs/02_data.md:143-145. requires_terms is this registry's policy: vesuvius.accept_terms records nothing a tool can read (accept_terms.py:41-48), so the acceptance must be recorded in the run configuration.

EDUCELAB-SCROLLS.name: EduceLab-Scrolls / Vesuvius Challenge data-server licence
obligations: Do not redistribute the data without the written approval of Vesuvius Challenge.
Do not make public (outside the official Vesuvius Challenge Discord) any revelation of hidden text or associated code without written approval.
In any published abstract, cite "EduceLab-Scrolls" as the source of the data.

In any published manuscript, reference Parsons, Parker, Chapman, Hayashida & Seales (2023), EduceLab-Scrolls: Verifiable Recovery of Text from Herculaneum Papyri using X-ray CT, arXiv:2304.02084, and acknowledge the dataset in the methods section.
Every team member accepts the terms individually.
EDUCELAB-SCROLLS.evidence: vesuvius/src/vesuvius/install/accept_terms.py:55-69 (EduceLab-Scrolls terms for Scrolls 1-4 and Fragments 1-6); scrollprize.org/docs/02_data.md:54,146; the data-server licence https://dl.ash2txt.org/LICENSE.txt. publication 'forbidden' is this registry's conservative reading: nothing derived is published without written approval.

VESUVIUS-DATA-TERMS.title: Vesuvius Challenge data terms as printed by vesuvius.accept_terms (CC BY-NC 4.0; EduceLab-Scrolls terms for Scrolls 1-4 and Fragments 1-6)
VESUVIUS-DATA-TERMS.evidence: vesuvius/src/vesuvius/install/accept_terms.py:52-70 (the text; line 59: 'if I am working in a team, every team member will sign this form separately'). vesuvius.accept_terms --yes only writes 'yes' to a package-local agreement.txt that nothing reads (accept_terms.py:41-48): it is not evidence of acceptance. Pinned: the sha256 of the bytes of the whole file accept_terms.py at villa e0bbb8b.

DATA-SERVER-LICENSE.title: Vesuvius Challenge data-server licence (https://dl.ash2txt.org/LICENSE.txt)
DATA-SERVER-LICENSE.evidence: The licence served at https://dl.ash2txt.org/LICENSE.txt: 'If I am working in a team, every member will agree to these terms individually.' Pinned: the sha256 of the bytes of LICENSE.txt as served with Last-Modified 2025-05-12. If the server's text changes, the pin no longer matches and an acceptance of the new text is refused until the pin is updated.

s3://vesuvius-challenge-open-data.note: The open-data bucket, us-east-1; both https spellings canonicalise here (scrollprize.org/src/data/atlasDataAccess.json:8-11; scrollprize.org/docs/02_data.md:60). Licence is per volume (the catalog keeps it at volumes[vid].properties.license); EduceLab is allowed because it is stricter.

s3://vesuvius-challenge.note: The full-dataset bucket, served at https://data.aws.ash2txt.org/samples/ (atlasDataAccess.json:12-15). It serves the EduceLab DLS volumes (scrollprize.org/static/data_browser/index.json:223-244) and other volumes, so the whole bucket defaults to the strictest licence; declare a narrower host entry for a volume you have checked to be CC BY-NC.

https://dl.ash2txt.org.note: The data server; its terms are https://dl.ash2txt.org/LICENSE.txt, required for every input here whatever licence a narrower entry allows. It hosts the spiral-fitting input datasets (scrollprize.org/docs/38_tutorial_spiral.md:109-113) and the legacy scroll volumes (vesuvius/src/vesuvius/install/configs/scrolls.yaml).

synthetic://apok-fixtures.note: Data apok-eval's own code generates; no scroll data. Generated data written to disk (the demo's, the tests') is declared in a run-local registry as file:// paths under its own root.

apok-synthetic-fixtures.evidence: Generated by apok-eval's own code (MIT, LICENSE); contains no scroll data.
apok-synthetic-fixtures.note: Names generated data, e.g. synthetic://apok-fixtures/spiral/seed-7. Clears without terms.
